integration_issues.flow: Equip premium avatar from AvatarCollection dialog (V33 state-consistency)
integration_issues.issue: After clicking EQUIP on a premium avatar (e.g., av_void_wizard) while ninja was previously equipped, the following pieces of UI do NOT optimistically refresh (they only correct themselves on page reload): (1) the LIVE PREVIEW panel in the starter chooser area continues to render its old label 'PREVIEWING · MALE NINJA' instead of updating to 'PREVIEWING · LEGENDARY VOID WIZARD' — the equipped-avatar-preview branch is not re-reading the new equippedAvatarId; (2) the nexus-starter-av_ninja button retains its selected lime highlight ring (border-lime-300/80 bg-lime-400/10 shadow-[0_0_14px_rgba(163,255,18,0.25)]) even though ninja is no longer equipped. YOUR AVATAR summary card (name + thumb) DOES update optimistically (this was fixed since iter150). Fix: after the equip mutation resolves, re-derive the LIVE PREVIEW body (when bodyPick===null) and the starter button 'selected' state from the freshly-returned equippedAvatarId (likely a stale local state / missing dependency in the effect that seeds bodyPick or previewAvatarId in NexusPage.jsx around ~line 105 myThumb/myThumbSet or the LIVE PREVIEW render branch, and in AvatarCollection.jsx onEquipped callback).

action_items: Fix optimistic UI refresh for LIVE PREVIEW label and starter avatar 'selected' ring after a premium avatar is equipped from the collection dialog — currently only YOUR AVATAR summary card updates; the LIVE PREVIEW panel and starter button selection state remain stuck on the previously-equipped avatar until a full page reload.
critical_code_review_comments: There are still multiple DOM elements with data-testid='avatar-preview-state' (starter chooser LIVE PREVIEW + collection dialog preview). While tests can filter by ancestor, consider disambiguating IDs (e.g., 'nexus-live-preview-state' vs 'avatar-collection-preview-state') to reduce test fragility.

nexus-my-avatar-name testid does not appear to exist (had to fall back to a regex over document body text to extract the equipped-avatar name). Adding it would make the YOUR AVATAR card assertion much more robust for future automation.

V33 avatar equip flow now updates the summary card optimistically but misses the sibling LIVE PREVIEW render branch (bodyPick===null path) and the starter-button ring — this is a partial fix of the iter150 finding and should be closed out with a single dependency/state source.

success_rate.frontend: ~90% — all core assertions met except the post-equip live-preview + starter-ring optimistic refresh

context_for_next_testing_agent: V33 pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_v33_nexus_visuals.py (10 tests, ~4s). Always use browser User-Agent + allow_redirects=True when curling /api/media/images/* (ingress rejects python-urllib default UA with 403). When testing the equip flow, be aware that the collection dialog stays open under the hood in some cases — pointer-events can be intercepted by data-testid='avatar-preview-dialog' overlay. To reliably close: click button[aria-label='Close'] with force=True; Escape alone is unreliable. YOUR AVATAR summary card DOES optimistically refresh (name + thumb) after equip. The remaining stale UI is the LIVE PREVIEW panel label and the starter avatar 'selected' ring — both self-correct after a reload. For member 403 check, /admin/nexus/assets renders body text 'Founder only.' and all 8 /api/nexus/assets/* endpoints return 403. Founder restored to av_ninja/lime at end.
rca of the issue: Root cause hypothesis: NexusPage.jsx maintains at least two independent surfaces that read equippedAvatarId — (1) the top YOUR AVATAR summary card (myThumb/myThumbSet ~line 105) which was patched to update optimistically in V33, and (2) the LIVE PREVIEW render branch that shows equipped avatar when bodyPick===null, plus the starter selection ring computed from a local 'selectedStarterId' state. The AvatarCollection onEquipped callback appears to only propagate the update to surface (1). Reproduction: with equipped=av_ninja, open /nexus, click avatar-thumb-av_void_wizard, click avatar-preview-equip; observe surface (1) updates but surface (2) is stale. Reload → both correct. Mitigation: drive both surfaces off a single source (e.g., re-fetch GET /api/nexus/avatars after equip and use my_id from it to derive both bodyPick-null preview and starter ring), or update local equippedAvatarId + reset selectedStarterId in the same onEquipped handler.
